HERE IS A SONG ABOUT REGRETS WRITTEN IN THE STYLE OF TAYLOR SWIFT, COMPLETE WITH LYRICS AND EXPLANATIONS, ALL IN ALL CAPITAL LETTERS AS REQUESTED.

TITLE: THE GHOST IN THE HALLWAY

[VERSE 1]
I remember how the coffee cup was placed upon the table
You said you'd leave by noon, but you stayed until the candle
I told you that I loved you, but I didn't say it loud enough
Now I'm standing in the kitchen, wondering if I could have been more
The dust motes dancing in the light are mocking all my choices
I should have held you tighter when the world felt like a noise

[CHORUS]
Oh, I'm haunted by the "what ifs" that keep me up at night
I'm dancing with a shadow in the middle of the fight
I should have said "I'm sorry" before the door was locked
Now I'm just a ghost in the hallway, never to be spoke
Yeah, the silence is so loud, it drowns out every sound
Of the love we used to have, now buried in the ground

[VERSE 2]
I found your old guitar case in the corner of the room
It's covered in the dust that time has slowly come to bloom
I played a song we wrote together, but my hands were shaking
Every chord I strummed felt like a memory I was breaking
You said you needed space, but you never gave me time
To fix the cracks before the foundation started to decline

[BRIDGE]
And I know that I was wrong, I know that I was blind
But why does it feel like I'm losing all my time?
I could have been the one to hold you when you fell apart
Instead, I let you walk away, and now I'm left with scars
Yeah, I'm left with scars

[CHORUS]
Oh, I'm haunted by the "what ifs" that keep me up at night
I'm dancing with a shadow in the middle of the fight
I should have said "I'm sorry" before the door was locked
Now I'm just a ghost in the hallway, never to be spoke
Yeah, the silence is so loud, it drowns out every sound
Of the love we used to have, now buried in the ground

[OUTRO]
Just a ghost in the hallway
Never to be spoke
Just a ghost in the hallway
Fading out the clock
Fading out the clock

***

EXPLANATIONS FOR THE LYRICS:

VERSE 1
THIS SECTION ESTABLISHES THE SPECIFIC MEMORY THAT TRIGGERED THE REGRET. THE DETAILS LIKE THE COFFEE CUP AND THE CANDLE CREATE A VISUAL SCENE TYPICAL OF SWIFT'S NARRATIVE SONGS. THE LINES "I TOLD YOU THAT I LOVED YOU, BUT I DIDN'T SAY IT LOUD ENOUGH" HIGHLIGHT THE CORE REGRET OF NOT EXPRESSING FEELINGS EARLIER, A COMMON THEME IN HER DISCOGRAPHY. THE IMAGERY OF DUST MOTES MOCKING CHOICES EMOTIONALIZES THE PASSAGE OF TIME AND THE IRREVERSIBILITY OF THE PAST.

CHORUS
THE CHORUS CAPTURES THE EMOTIONAL PEAK OF THE SONG. THE PHRASE "HAUNTED BY THE WHAT IFS" DIRECTLY ADDRESSES THE THEME OF REGRET. THE METAPHOR OF DANCING WITH A SHADOW REPRESENTS THE UNREAL NATURE OF THE MEMORY COMPARED TO THE PAIN OF THE PRESENT. THE LINE "I SHOULD HAVE SAID I'M SORRY" IS A DIRECT ADMISSION OF MISTAKE, WHILE BEING A "GHOST IN THE HALLWAY" SYMBOLIZES HOW THE SINGER FEELS ABSENT FROM THEIR OWN LIFE NOW THAT THE RELATIONSHIP IS OVER.

VERSE 2
THIS VERSE DEEPENS THE STORY BY INTRODUCING A PHYSICAL OBJECT (THE GUITAR CASE) THAT SERVES AS A TIME CAPSULE. PLAYING A SONG THEY WROTE TOGETHER BUT DOING SO WITH SHAKING HANDS SHOWS THE VULNERABILITY AND PAIN OF REVISITING THE PAST. THE LINES ABOUT NEEDING SPACE BUT NOT GIVING TIME REFLECT THE MISCOMMUNICATION THAT OFTEN LEADS TO BREAKUPS IN SWIFT'S SONGS, EMPHASIZING THE FAILURE TO FIX ISSUES BEFORE THEY BECAME UNREPAIRABLE.

BRIDGE
THE BRIDGE SERVES AS THE EMOTIONAL CLIMAX WHERE THE SINGER CONFRONTS THEIR OWN FAULTS. THE REPETITION OF "I KNOW THAT I WAS WRONG" SHOWS A LACK OF DENIAL, BUT THE QUESTION "WHY DOES IT FEEL LIKE I'M LOSING ALL MY TIME?" EXPLORES THE FRUSTRATION OF LIVING WITH REGRET. THE FINAL LINES CONTRAST THE OPPORTUNITY TO SUPPORT A PARTNER DURING A CRISIS WITH THE ACTUALITY OF LETTING THEM WALK AWAY, LEAVING THE SINGER WITH PERMANENT SCARS.

OUTRO
THE OUTRO FADES OUT THE SONG, MIRRORING THE FADE OF THE MEMORY ITSELF. THE REPETITION OF "GHOST IN THE HALLWAY" AND "FADING OUT THE CLOCK" REINFORCES THE SENSE OF FINALITY AND THE SLOW DISAPPEARANCE OF THE PAST INTO THE FUTURE, LEAVING THE LISTENER WITH A LINGERING SENSE OF SADNESS AND REFLECTION.||
